messages:
Ravi K: Heads up — MedCrest just submitted a 42-page vendor risk form. They specifically asked for: full SOC2/ISO attestation, list of subprocessors, embeddings retention policy, API key rotation proof, and our data deletion playbook. They marked this high for renewal.
Nora S: Ugh 42 pages. Do they want raw evidence or just answered form fields?
Ravi K: Their note: "Please attach evidentiary docs where applicable; consolidated packet preferred." Also asked for an ETA within 72 hours.
Tom B (Security): Priority order from sec POV: 1) SOC2 cert + control mapping, 2) subprocessors list and contracts summary, 3) embeddings retention policy + retention screenshots from console, 4) API key rotation policy + sample logs (redacted). We CANNOT provide logs with user PII.
Evelyn (Legal): We should require signed DPA addendum before sharing contract-level docs. Also advise limiting subprocessors to our published list + last-reviewed date. I'll prepare a standard acceptance clause for the packet: vendor signature required.
qa-bot: Reminder: run piiscan on artifacts before upload: `./tools/pii-scan --level=strict --output=artifact_manifest.json`.
Nora S: Suggest we offer two deliverables: (A) Completed form (answers only) + references/links to published artifacts; (B) Evidence bundle after DPA addendum signed (contains certs, redacted logs, retention screenshots). That will buy us time and reduce prod sharing.
Ravi K: Draft reply to MedCrest below — please edit:
```
Hi Elena / MedCrest team,

Thanks for the questionnaire. We can complete the form fields and provide a scoped evidence bundle, but before we share contract-level artifacts (e.g., subprocessor contracts, detailed logs) we require execution of our DPA addendum. Proposed plan:

1) We will return the completed questionnaire (answers + links to public docs) within 48 hours.
2) Upon DPA addendum execution, we will deliver the Evidence Bundle (SOC2 Type II cert, control mapping, subprocessors list, redacted rotation logs, retention policy docs) within 72 hours.

Please confirm and we will send the DPA addendum for signature. If you need anything expedited, flag the specific control IDs and business justification and we will route for exec approval.

Best,
Ravi on behalf of Redwood CS
```
Tom B (Security): Edits: add line about no production screenshots or raw DB extracts, and that logs will be redacted. Also add link to our subprocessors page: https://redwood.internal/compliance/subprocessors
Evelyn (Legal): I'll attach the DPA addendum draft to the portal and cc the MedCrest counsel. Upload location: https://redwood.internal/legal/drafts/medcrest-dpa-v1.docx
Nora S: I'll start filling the form answers using the vendor-responder template. ETA for initial answers: 24h.
qa-bot: Note: auto-template merge tool: `./tools/vfr merge --template vendor_template.xlsx --answers answers.md --out VendorForm_Filled.xlsx`
Ravi K: Good. Also flagging renewal risk: MedCrest spends ~$18k/mo; this is an account to keep warm. We'll mark this as renewal-risk=medium-high on the account board.
Tom B (Security): Security review scheduled in 2 hours for the filled answers before we send the initial completed form. I'll triage any claims that reference prod-only artifacts.
Evelyn (Legal): Confirmed — I'll require the DPA signed before evidence bundle. If they push for immediate evidence, escalate to Dir Legal + Head CS.
Nora S: Quick sync at 10:30 to triage outstanding form items and confirm the filled answers.
Ravi K: Thanks team — posting timeline and owners in the ticket and will ping MedCrest after Nora posts initial answers. :thumbsup:
